title: Consistent path through a decision tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $T$ be a binary decision tree on $n$ coordinates with output labels in $\alpha$. For every input $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, some path in the list of paths of $T$ is consistent with $x$ at every coordinate assigned along that path.
hypotheses_covered: Tree $T$ over an available subset of the $n$ coordinates
